'''Cardya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who owned [[Meliflar Station]]. In [[44 ABY]], Cardya was part of a group that was sent to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Ben Skywalker]], and [[Vestara Khai]] and capture the ''[[Jade Shadow]]''. After [[Abeloth]]'s visit to the station, Cardya mutinied against the station's leader, [[Hallaf]].
